## Thank you for filing a pull request for Woof!
Please make sure the following conditions are fulfilled:
- [ ] Please add a brief description of your changes to the [Changelog](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md), and sort it under either *New Features and Improvements*, *Bug Fixes*, or *Miscellaneous*.
- [ ] If your changes contains a significant contribution (measures vary) by yourself, please add yourself to the copyright holders in the source file header and the [README](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/README.md) file.
- [ ] If you change or add code or assets *by others*, please confirm that this contribution is licensed under a GPL-2+ compatible license and add that license and the copyright holder to both the source file header (if applicable) and the [README](https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/woof/blob/master/README.md) file.
